newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Heavy extends gains on earnings hopes.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Heavy extends gains on earnings hopes.

text.p: Shares of Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd advanced in active trade on Wednesday morning, supported by expectations that the automaker's earnings would be better than its own estimate for the 1996/97 business year, traders said.
The share price was 14 yen higher at 604 at 0129 GMT. Its turnover of 4.435 million was the second heaviest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
"The shares were supported by Fuji Heavy's expected large profits for the past fiscal year," said a broker at a second-tier Japanese securities house.

Fuji Heavy itself said on Monday that it had revised up its current profit estimate for 1996/97 to 33.80 billion yen from its previous estimate of 26.00 billion. It posted current profits of 10.11 billion a year ago.
